summary: Select reconciler ownership candidates once per pass and filter remote workspace work early

replay.detail: No replay, rebuild or durable projection change. The pass uses a short read snapshot to select candidates and freshly rechecks authority before guarded effects and cached-wake result reporting.

schema.detail: No schema, index or trigger changes. Selection uses the existing staged-subject predicate and lets SQLite select the index.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, canonical ranking and retained authority history are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or harness contract change. Remote placement-away and stops remain in the full candidate roster; newly eligible subjects can wait until the next pass.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary upgrade.

manual.detail: No migration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes. Existing effect fences remain; ownership selection is process-local and recomputed for each pass. Unexpected ownership read failures fence work and produce a shared bounded diagnostic.
